limitations.description: The live service still executes the institution-scale dev checkout (2 unmerged commits past a merged base, plus uncommitted local edits), not current main. Blocker: main's release identity (canonical/release.py v22, matching main's committed root artifacts) rejects the served v25 runtime artifact lineage built by the census lane; deploying main's server against the v25 runtime fails its release guard, and re-cutting the runtime from main's v22 artifacts would regress served content. Resolution requires reconciling the v25 release lineage into main - tracked as the remaining step for the runtime-deployment receipt; #120 therefore stays status:code-merged.
